notes: Team time trial, 19.6 km, ridden once, point to point from the Fòrum (Sant Martí) to the Estadi Olímpic on Montjuïc. km 0 is placed on Avinguda del Litoral at the Parc del Fòrum / Diagonal Mar end (41.40722, 2.22060), medium confidence: the start ramp has no published coordinates, and this point makes the first itinerary row (2.6 km, Port Olímpic turn into Carrer de l'Arquitecte Sert) match the routed path exactly. Itinerary from the PIMEC timetable (kms to 0.1 km): 2.6 Litoral -> Arquitecte Sert, 2.7 Salvador Espriu, 3.0 Jaume Vicens i Vives, 3.1 Carmen Amaya, 3.5 Passeig de Calvell, 4.0 Passeig de Garcia Fària, 4.4 Bac de Roda, 4.9 Llull, 5.1 intermediate time check 1, 5.6 tram level crossing / Josep Pla, 6.7 Cantàbria, 7.2 Rambla de Guipúscoa, 8.2 Aragó, 9.8 Lepant, 10.1 Mallorca, 10.3 Sagrada Família, 10.5 time check 2, 10.9 Plaça de Mossèn Jacint Verdaguer, 11.8 Passeig de Gràcia, 12.0 Aragó, 14.3 Tarragona, 14.6 Plaça d'Espanya, 15.2 Avinguda de Rius i Taulet, 15.5 Carrer de Lleida, 15.9 Passeig de Santa Madrona (time check 3, foot of the climb), 16.8 Avinguda de l'Estadi, 17.0 'Pujada de Montjuïc' (top), 17.9 Jocs del 92, 18.8 Carrer del Foc, 18.9 Passeig Olímpic, 19.6 finish. The beteve closure list gives the same street sequence. Routed on Overture streets the course measures 19.75-19.86 km (about 1 % longer than 19.6). To keep every straight-line distance <= km difference, the km of each junction was re-derived from the routed path between km 0 and the finish; all stay within 0.2 km of the itinerary values (confidence 'high' only where the difference is <= 0.12 km, otherwise 'medium'). The time checks have no published spot and sit at their path-derived km. Avinguda del Litoral is ridden south-westwards on closed roads, partly against the mapped one-way direction, so one-way restrictions were ignored except on motorways/trunks. From Avinguda de la Reina Maria Cristina the course goes over Avinguda de Rius i Taulet and Carrer de Lleida to Passeig de Santa Madrona; its hairpins up to Avinguda de l'Estadi have extra points (straight/km ratio below 0.6 there is expected). Finish: Passeig Olímpic in front of the Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys (41.36470, 2.15764), at the top of the ~700 m rise from Carrer del Foc; the same finish point is used for stage 2. Points named '(between ...)' are routing fill points about 1 km apart.
